boards.name: ESP32-2432S028R (2.8", USB-C + micro-USB)
boards.recognise: Yellow board, 2.8" screen, a USB-C and a micro-USB port; ESP32-2432S028 printed on the back.

boards.name: ESP32-2432S028R (2.8", micro-USB only)
boards.recognise: Yellow board, 2.8" screen, one micro-USB port; ESP32-2432S028 printed on the back. The original CYD.

boards.name: ESP32-2432S028R (2.8", USB-C + micro-USB, ST7789 screen)
boards.recognise: Like the USB-C + micro-USB 2.8" board, but with an ST7789 screen (the screen doesn't answer the ID read, so choose it by hand).

boards.name: ESP32-2432S024R (2.4")
boards.recognise: 2.4" screen with resistive touch; ESP32-2432S024R printed on the back.
boards.touch_note: calibration taken from the 2.8" board; may be off

boards.name: ESP32-2432S024C (2.4")
boards.recognise: 2.4" screen with capacitive touch; ESP32-2432S024C printed on the back.

boards.name: ESP32-2432S032R (3.2")
boards.recognise: 3.2" IPS screen with resistive touch; ESP32-2432S032R printed on the back.
boards.touch_note: calibration taken from the 2.8" board; may be off

boards.name: ESP32-2432S032C (3.2")
boards.recognise: 3.2" IPS screen with capacitive touch; ESP32-2432S032C printed on the back.

boards.name: ESP32-3248S035R (3.5")
boards.recognise: 3.5" screen (480 x 320) with resistive touch; ESP32-3248S035R printed on the back.
boards.touch_note: calibration taken from the 2.8" board; may be off

boards.name: ESP32-3248S035C (3.5")
boards.recognise: 3.5" screen (480 x 320) with capacitive touch; ESP32-3248S035C printed on the back.

boards.name: JC2432W328C (2.8", Guition, capacitive touch)
boards.recognise: 2.8" IPS screen with capacitive touch; JC2432W328C printed on the back (Guition).
